name: Kobayashi Akira
source:
[url=/c85105]Shoutarou's[/url] childhood friend who's involved with the kaiju investigation bureau. They were close before, but something happened that tore them apart. Strangely enough, his name is also "Akira".  Seems that Shoutarou has a type? 

[Spoiler]Furthermore, he's a member of "Orange", a resistance group who fight for kaiju rights… or so it seems.[/spoiler]  

[Based on the [url=https://adeltaz1.wixsite.com/uuultrac/blank-14]official description[/url]]  

A champion of justice whose motto is "protect the weak". 

He hates lies and deception and is quick to right wrongs no matter what the reason.  

[Spoiler]The crumbling of his first love toward Shoutarou was powerful enough to leave him traumatized.  

His wife was a former victim of bullying who is compelled to help others in need.  

To make up for his past, he does his best to make her happy, and it's her trust in him that allows him to get on with his life.[/spoiler]  

[From the in-game description]
